prompt: In a photorealistic photo of a grand library reading room, sunlight filters through tall windows onto polished oak tables. On the left, a student in a blue hoodie sits hunched over an open textbook, their posture rigid with concentration. Next to them, a stack of leather-bound books rests precariously on the table edge, their spines cracked and faded from age. In the center, an elderly woman in a floral blouse points gently at a map spread across the surface, her finger tracing a specific route. Beside her, a young man in glasses looks intently at the same map, his brow furrowed in curiosity as he absorbs the information. To the right, a tabby cat sleeps soundly on a velvet armchair, its body curled into a tight ball of orange and black stripes. Near the cat, a potted fern stands tall in a ceramic pot, its fronds cascading down toward the floor in lush green waves. The student in the blue hoodie is handing a pencil to the elderly woman in the floral blouse, who reaches out to accept it with a grateful smile. There is no digital screen visible anywhere in the scene, preserving the timeless analog atmosphere of the space. The warm light highlights the dust motes dancing in the air, adding texture to the quiet moment of shared learning and rest.
